messages:
Maya Patel: Quick alignment ask — partners are sending inconsistent supply CSVs. can we publish a minimal ingest CSV spec (reserved vs spot + credit timing + eviction stats) and require it for marketplace listings?

Jon Kim: absolutely. finance needs: reserved_hour_usd, spot_hour_usd, reserve_tenor_months, reserved_commit_min_hours, billing_credit_type, credit_lag_days, currency.

Priya Rao: add eviction_rate_pct, eviction_window_hours, preemptibility_type, min_reserve_granularity_hours, sku, region, gpu_type, available_from, deprecation_date. these drive routing and migration modeling.

Evan Li: routing cares about eviction windows — if eviction_window_hours < 12 or eviction_rate_pct > 3% mark as "avoid-for-p99". we should ask partners to provide monthly eviction pct.

Kelsey (CoreWeave): we'll map to that. sample sanitized row we'll send: cw-a100-80-usw,us-west,A100-80,3.20,0.85,12,720,monthly,14,USD,2.5,6,preemptible,720,2025-01-01,

Maya Patel: perfect. Priya can you draft a one-pager mapping each column to semantics and examples? partnerships will push to vendors and marketplace will enforce during onboarding.

Priya Rao: on it. will include contract_ref and notes about one-time vs monthly credits so finance can amortize properly.

Jon Kim: i'll add credit_lag_days into the cost template for cashflow modeling.

Evan Li: i'll add a simple routing rule: tags from SKU metadata can trigger "preferred" or "avoid-for-p99".

Kelsey (CoreWeave): sending full CSV tomorrow with regional breakdown and min purchase sizes.

supply-bot: Reminder — drop final CSV into partnerships/vendor-supply Drive folder within 48 hours.
